question: Which printmaking technique involves drawing on a flat stone or metal plate with a greasy medium, then applying water and ink to create prints based on the principle that oil and water repel each other?
options: Intaglio
Lithography
Screen printing

options: Modernism
Negritude
Surrealism
Impressionism

options: Welding metal pieces together
Casting molten bronze in a mold
Carving away material from a block of marble

question: Which element of art refers to the perceived surface quality of a work, which can be actual or simulated?
options: Form
Value
Texture
Space

options: Analogous
Complementary

options: Edna Manley

The strong contrast between light and dark to create the illusion of three-dimensional form

Genre refers to the category or subject matter of a work (e.g., portraiture, landscape), while medium refers to the materials and techniques used to create it
